| description = Name is apparently classicly mispelled with a z.

Always spawns wielding a braid.

In [[The Overthere]], wandering Sarnaks may be knights or berzerkers. Berzerkers can also be found at the ruins located at #8 and #10 on the map, where [[PH]]s may include [[a sarnak enthusiast]], [[a sarnak partisan]], and [[a sarnak knight]]. Be aware that goons patrol through the ruins nightly between 10PM and 2AM to cleanse them of Sarnakian filth and won't hesitate to take you out with them.

A static spawn on a 6:00 timer exists in [[The Overthere]] at roughly (1506, 2307) just south of the gargoyles near the path. A patrolling spawn on a 6:40 timer starts at (1548, 3554) to the southwest and unwisely wanders too close to said gargoyles, which will aggro all sarnak. From this spot anyone can get the guards to kill the PHs and solo a few berserkers an hour.
